basic_profile.bio: Avid tech enthusiast and Minecraft aficionado based in Wellington, New Zealand. When not tending to my small urban garden, I can be found tinkering with network configurations and providing tech support to friends and family. Occasionally, I dive into the world of digital gaming, with a special affinity for classic titles like Minecraft. My typical online hours are late evenings, after my day job as a systems analyst. Happily single and enjoying the flexibility that comes with it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in IT, I have developed a solid foundation in networking, cybersecurity, and software development. My knowledge is bolstered by a passion for self-learning through online courses and community engagement.
